title: A part with only a -2 bin shows -2 and -$20 and lowers the totals
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two tracked parts for this test at a cost of $10.00 and a Sell Price of $20.00: part A with 0 in its only bin and part B with 4 in its only bin.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line while its bin holds 0, so part A's bin goes to -2.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.
custom_steps:
1. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the report's Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed, not left out: Qty -2.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost -$20.00 (-2 × $10.00).
  • Part A's row has Total Sell -$40.00 (-2 × $20.00) and Margin -$20.00, and its Margin % shows the dash "—" because the row is negative.
  • Part B is listed with Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00.
  • The Totals row reads Qty 2.00 and Total Cost $20.00 (4 + (-2) = 2; $40.00 + (-$20.00) = $20.00), not 4.00 and $40.00, which would mean part A was left out.

  • Feature Overview, Accounting: “Inventory Value figures already saved for past dates keep their saved values. The count of bins below zero, which ships with this release, applies from release on and does not rework earlier dates.”

From: Product's answers (Chris Ward, 9 Oct and 14 Oct 2026, saved in po-answers-2026-10-09/ and po-answers-2026-10-14/), read 27 Oct 2026

  • QA lead, 9 Oct 2026, set-up answer 1: “Negative bin can be when you order the inventory part on a work order line when the quantity is already ZERO”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10380, description, Acceptance criteria: “A -2-only part appears with quantity -2 and cost value -$20 and reduces report totals accordingly.”
